learningStrategy.title: Senior ownership through shipped evidence
learningStrategy.summary: This 44-week sequence starts with your existing experience, deepens backend and AI delivery, and ends with senior-level ownership and a qualified remote application pipeline. Apply early when evidence matches. Pace the calendar around work and energy.

steps.title: Position and prepare
steps.detail: Audit CV evidence, target senior scope and start qualified applications.

steps.title: Backend and data depth
steps.detail: Strengthen C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, architecture and business invariants.

steps.title: Reliable delivery
steps.detail: Build distributed-systems judgment, containers, cloud and CI habits.

steps.title: Production AI
steps.detail: Integrate .NET AI, measure RAG, secure tools and practice operations.

steps.title: Senior ownership
steps.detail: Practice design review, mentoring, interviews and application feedback.

learningStrategy.rule: Each week produces inspectable evidence. Separate professional experience, existing projects and planned work. A local demo is not a production-scale claim.

weeks.title: Verify your CV against real evidence
weeks.objective: Check every job date, title, technology and achievement against your records, repositories or other proof. Correct uncertain claims before applying.

tasks.text: Copy every CV bullet into a table with columns: claim, where it happened, your exact contribution, proof/link, and status (professional work, existing personal project, or planned).
Check employer names, titles and month/year dates against your own records. Specifically confirm the Chainomation start date shown as December 2026–Present on the supplied resume.
Remove or rewrite claims you cannot prove. Do not invent impact numbers; mark an unknown fact for confirmation.
Create a corrected CV draft that leads with .NET backend, business systems and your verified AI projects.

weeks.deliverable: An evidence table for every CV claim, a corrected CV draft, and a short list of facts you still need to confirm.

steps: List each CV claim and label it professional experience, existing personal project, or planned work.
Confirm all employment dates, titles, technologies and responsibilities against records you trust.
Attach one proof item to every important claim: a public repository, sanitized work example, reference, or accurate explanation.
Rewrite unsupported claims and metrics; ask for confirmation on uncertain dates before using the CV.
learningGuide.practice: Audit your supplied resume one section at a time. Correct the Chainomation date only after confirming the actual start date.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Every CV statement is accurate, your contribution is clear, important claims have evidence, and uncertain facts are flagged instead of guessed.

weeks.title: Find and compare senior remote vacancies
weeks.objective: Use actual job postings to learn which senior .NET/backend and AI engineering roles hire in Bangladesh and what evidence they expect.

tasks.text: Find 10–15 active senior vacancies for Senior .NET Backend, Senior Backend, Senior AI Integration or Applied AI roles. Save the direct posting link and date checked.
For each posting record: Bangladesh/contractor eligibility and source, UTC overlap, senior responsibilities, required stack, three evidence matches, and gaps.
Count the requirements that repeat across postings. Separate must-have skills from optional tools and ignore roles that cannot hire from Bangladesh.
Save five qualified roles in Remote jobs. Apply to the two strongest matches now; record the CV version, proof links, date and follow-up.

weeks.deliverable: A comparison of 10–15 real senior vacancies, five qualified roles in your tracker, two tailored applications, and a prioritized skills-gap list.

steps: Search for the senior titles in your target list on company career sites and remote job boards.
Open the employer posting. Confirm location/contract eligibility; do not infer worldwide availability from the word remote.
Record responsibilities, required skills, UTC hours, proof you can show and missing evidence in a comparison table.
Use repeated gaps to choose what to study. Apply now when your evidence already matches; the roadmap is not a gate.
learningGuide.practice: Use the Remote jobs page to save qualified postings and follow-ups. Note where each eligibility decision came from.
learningGuide.readyWhen: You can explain why each saved vacancy fits, show evidence for its key requirements, and identify the exact next action for each application.

weeks.title: Turn real work into senior interview examples
weeks.objective: Prepare accurate examples that show your contribution, technical judgment, collaboration and follow-through on real work.

tasks.text: Choose three real examples from your ERP/CRM, inventory/accounting, insurance, chatbot or summarizer work. Do not use a planned feature as an experience story.
For each example write: context/problem, constraints, your exact role, options, decision and why, implementation/collaboration, verified result, lesson, and proof.
Separate your work from the team's work. If you have no verified metric, describe the observable result without inventing a number.
Record a 90-second answer for each story. Listen once, remove vague claims, and make your own contribution easy to understand.

weeks.deliverable: Three concise, truthful senior interview stories with evidence links, clear ownership boundaries and a recorded spoken version.

steps: Select three completed examples that you personally worked on and can discuss in detail.
Use a consistent story structure: problem and constraints; your responsibility; options; decision; delivery and collaboration; result; what you learned.
Attach an artifact where possible: sanitized design note, pull request, project link, screenshot or colleague who can confirm the work.
Practice out loud. State what you did, what the team did, what you would change, and which results you can actually verify.
learningGuide.practice: Use one real budget approval, accounting/inventory rule, CRM feature or AI-project failure. Protect employer/client confidential details.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Each story is truthful, answers what you personally owned, explains a decision and its trade-offs, and fits a concise interview answer.

weeks.title: Prepare and send tailored applications
weeks.objective: Turn your verified CV, interview examples and project evidence into a clear application for specific senior vacancies.

tasks.text: Create two CV summaries: Senior .NET Backend and Senior AI Integration. Reorder skills and evidence for the vacancy; keep employment history and claims consistent.
For each application write a short role-specific note mapping three job requirements to your verified evidence and links. State gaps honestly.
Update LinkedIn/GitHub headlines and project summaries to match the CV. Link only to repositories that open and have truthful descriptions.
Submit three to five well-matched applications if eligible; add status, date, CV version and a sensible follow-up date to the tracker.

weeks.deliverable: Two targeted CV summaries, consistent professional profiles, three to five tracked applications, and next actions for each.

steps: Choose a real vacancy and highlight its senior responsibilities and top three technical requirements.
Reorder the CV summary, skills and project evidence to match those needs without changing factual claims.
Check links, dates, spelling, location eligibility and requested working-hour overlap.
Submit through the employer's stated process. Log the exact CV version, evidence links, status and follow-up.
learningGuide.practice: Tailor one application for a senior .NET role and one for a senior AI integration role, if suitable eligible vacancies are available.
learningGuide.readyWhen: Each application is accurate, tailored to a verified eligible vacancy, linked to evidence, and saved with a follow-up action.
